claim: GOLFWIN.EXE v1.014 contains 13 12-byte club physics records at VA 0x41F108; each record provides vertical base, horizontal base and power scale, with club index 12 on the putter path.

sources.observation: Routine around VA 0x40A1C1 computes club_index*12, loads three dwords from 0x41F108, halves the first two, and stores them as per-shot V/H base plus power scaling.

notes: Exact display names/order for indices 0-11 remain unverified; index 12 is supported as putter by the special zero-vertical ground path.
